title: Oozing Spicy Kenyan Cheese Quesadilla
description: A spicy and indulgent Kenyan dish featuring shredded Mexican cheese, perfect for vegetarians, with a flaky and crispy texture.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, diced chili peppers, and curry powder.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle a quarter of the cheese mixture onto half of the tortilla.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and cheese mixture.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
